title: 嘉维资本Leonid：25倍估值合理，CXMT成中国AI核心标的？
speaker: Leonid Miranov

segments.en: We're 10 times 20, 27 earnings. What should that valuation be then, do you think? Well, I mean, that is up to the market to decide, but for me, if a company, again, just listing the characteristics, right, it's growing, it's a domestic champion, it's a company that's delivering on the promises of the 15th, 5-year plan, honestly, would 25 times be out of the question.
segments.zh: 我们目前是2027年盈利的10倍。你认为估值应该是多少？这由市场决定，但对我来说，如果一家公司具备这些特征：增长、国内龙头、兑现十五五规划承诺，那么25倍并非不可能。

segments.en: If it was at 25 times, these are exactly the reasons we would use to explain why it's at 25 times, because at some point, it stops being just a memory company, and it becomes much more, it becomes the sort of the default China AI play, right?
segments.zh: 如果它达到25倍，我们就会用这些理由来解释为什么是25倍。因为在某个时点，它不再只是一家存储公司，而成为更具代表性的中国AI核心标的。
